Question 2
?

Let B={b1,b2,b3} be a basis of R3 and [x]B=[4−27]. What are the coordinates of x relative to the basis C={c1,c2,c3}, where c1=−b3, c2=12b1 and c3=2b2?

a
[x]C=[−78−1]
b
[x]C=[−4−472]
c
[x]C=[1−87]
d
[x]C=[−1122]
e
[x]C=[72−4]
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Since [x]B=[4−27], we can write x as follows:

x=4b1−2b2+7b3=7b3+4b1−2b2=−7(−b3)+8(12b1)−(2b2)=−7c1+8c2−c3

Therefore, [x]C=[−78−1].
